ewn.summary: The Netherlands (EWN) cycle is structurally dominated by ASML, which is roughly 22-23% of EWN's portfolio, making the ETF a de-facto leveraged proxy for global semiconductor capex and AI-chip-equipment sentiment. Tops and troughs align tightly with ASML's order-book cycles rather than with broad European macro. A second, persistent amplifier is the EUR/USD rate: because EWN is USD-denominated, euro appreciation adds a tailwind on top of local gains, while euro weakness drags on USD-translated returns even when local equities rise. Energy names such as Shell add a secondary commodity overlay. Dutch equities broadly benefit from ECB easing and global risk-on phases and suffer during tightening, energy shocks, or trade disruption, given the Netherlands' outsized role as a European export hub.
ewn.summary_zh: 荷兰（EWN）的周期结构高度集中于ASML，其在EWN中的权重约为22%-23%，使该ETF实际上成为全球半导体资本支出与AI芯片设备情绪的杠杆化代理工具。因此，周期顶点与低谷高度契合于ASML的订单周期，而非欧洲宏观大环境。第二个持续性放大器是欧元/美元汇率：由于EWN以美元计价，欧元升值在本地涨幅之上提供顺风，而欧元走弱则在本地股票上涨时仍拖累美元计价回报。壳牌等能源股构成次级大宗商品叠加层。受益于欧洲央行宽松及全球风险偏好阶段，荷兰股票整体走强；而在欧央行收紧、能源冲击或贸易受阻时则承压，原因在于荷兰是欧洲重要的出口枢纽。

ewi.summary: Italy (EWI) is a high-beta peripheral European market whose cycles are driven by three overlapping forces: sovereign risk premium (the BTP-Bund spread), EUR/USD dynamics, and the global risk-appetite toggle. Because EWI is USD-denominated, a weakening euro mechanically deepens drawdowns and a strengthening euro amplifies rallies in USD terms, making currency a second-order amplifier on every move. The index is heavily concentrated in financials and energy, so banking-sector health, ECB policy, and commodity cycles act as primary cycle accelerators. Troughs have historically aligned with sovereign stress, risk-off flight-to-quality, or political standoffs with the EU; recoveries have followed ECB credibility backstops (Draghi's 2012 pledge, PEPP) and compressing BTP spreads. The 2022-2026 super-cycle rally — the longest and largest in the window — was powered by ECB rate hikes widening Italian bank net interest margins, EU recovery-fund disbursements anchoring sovereign credibility, and a globally synchronized risk-on episode.
ewi.summary_zh: 意大利ETF（EWI）是高贝塔欧洲外围市场，周期受三重力量主导：主权风险溢价（BTP-德债利差）、欧元兑美元走势，以及全球风险偏好开关。由于EWI以美元计价，欧元走弱在美元维度机械性地加深下跌、欧元走强则放大上涨，汇率始终是每轮行情的二阶放大器。指数高度集中于金融和能源，因此银行业健康状况、欧央行政策与大宗商品周期是主要的周期加速器。历史低点通常与主权压力、避险抛售或与欧盟的政治对峙同步；复苏则往往跟随欧央行公信力背书（德拉吉2012年承诺、PEPP）与BTP利差收窄。2022-2026年超级上行周期由欧央行加息扩大意大利银行净息差、欧盟复苏基金拨款锚定主权公信力，以及全球同步风险偏好上升共同驱动。

Banking sector health: bank net interest margins and credit quality set the tone

ewp.summary: Spain's cycle is defined by its sensitivity to ECB credit policy and Eurozone sovereign risk premiums. The IBEX 35 is dominated by large universal banks whose profitability swings sharply with European rate cycles, and by multinationals with heavy emerging-market exposure (Santander and BBVA derive large revenues from Brazil, Mexico, Turkey and Argentina), making Spanish equities a leveraged proxy on both European monetary policy and global EM risk appetite. Cycle troughs have coincided with sovereign-debt stress or broad EM risk-off episodes; peaks have tracked ECB accommodation and synchronized DM expansion. The EUR/USD component is critical: EWP's USD-denominated returns are amplified when the euro strengthens and dampened when it weakens, adding a second-order layer beyond the IBEX itself. Spain's structural tourism dependency (roughly 12-13% of GDP) embeds additional cyclical momentum into recoveries.
ewp.summary_zh: 西班牙市场周期高度依赖欧洲央行信贷政策与欧元区主权风险溢价。IBEX 35由大型全能银行主导，其盈利能力随欧洲利率周期大幅波动；桑坦德与BBVA在巴西、墨西哥、土耳其、阿根廷拥有大量收入来源，使西班牙股市成为欧洲货币政策与全球新兴市场风险偏好的双重杠杆代理。周期底部往往与主权债务压力或新兴市场风险厌恶高峰重合，顶部则对应欧洲央行宽松与发达市场同步扩张。欧元/美元汇率至关重要：欧元升值时EWP的美元回报被放大，贬值时则受压制，构成IBEX本身之外的二阶波动层。西班牙旅游业约占GDP的12-13%，为市场复苏注入额外周期动能。

ewl.summary: Switzerland's ETF cycle is dominated by three structural forces. First, extreme index concentration in healthcare (Novartis, Roche) and consumer staples (Nestle), which together make up a large share of index weight and give EWL a defensive, low-beta profile. Second, the safe-haven CHF, which is a double-edged FX overlay: a surging franc on flight-to-quality drags USD returns even when local equities are flat, while a weakening franc lets local gains translate more fully for USD investors. Third, global pharma and defensive earnings cycles, which set the tempo of multi-year up-legs. Because the giants are dollar-earning multinationals, a strong CHF also compresses their reported CHF earnings, layering a fundamental headwind onto the pure currency-translation loss. Tops tend to form after sustained defensive outperformance or sharp CHF appreciation; troughs cluster around global risk-off liquidation events where even Swiss defensives are sold, only to recover faster than cyclical peers.
ewl.summary_zh: EWL的周期由三股结构性力量主导。其一，医疗（诺华、罗氏）与消费必需品（雀巢）的极度集中，合计占指数较大权重，赋予EWL防御性、低贝塔特征。其二，避险瑞郎构成双刃汇率叠加：避险资金推升瑞郎时，即便本地股市持平也会拖累美元回报；瑞郎走弱时则使本地涨幅更充分地传导给美元投资者。其三，全球制药与防御性盈利周期决定多年上升趋势的节奏。由于三大巨头均为赚取美元的跨国公司，瑞郎走强还会压缩其瑞郎报告盈利，在纯汇率折算损失之外叠加一层基本面阻力。顶部往往在防御性超额收益持续较久或瑞郎大幅升值后出现；底部则集中于全球风险规避清仓时期，即便瑞士防御股亦遭抛售，但随后反弹快于周期性同类。

ewq.summary: France's equity cycle is anchored in globally-oriented large-caps across luxury goods, aerospace, energy, and industrials, whose earnings are tied to global growth more than to the domestic economy alone. The USD-listed ETF adds a EUR/USD layer that can amplify or dilute local returns by 5-15% per year, making ECB policy stance and euro direction central cycle variables. Major troughs have consistently followed Eurozone systemic stress or global risk-off events, resolved by ECB intervention or a political clearing event. Tops have emerged when global growth expectations moderate, the euro overshoots, or domestic political and fiscal uncertainty peaks. The 2022-2026 up-leg showed that France can sustain a long recovery while carrying persistent fiscal deficits, provided the ECB backstop remains credible.
ewq.summary_zh: 法国股市周期以奢侈品、航空航天、能源和工业领域的全球化大盘股为锚，这些公司的盈利更多与全球增长挂钩，而非仅依赖国内经济。该USD计价ETF额外叠加了欧元/美元汇率层，可使本地回报每年被放大或稀释5-15%，令欧央行政策立场与欧元走向成为核心周期变量。历次重要低点均发生在欧元区系统性压力或全球避险事件之后，由欧央行干预或政治格局清晰化来化解。顶部往往出现在全球增长预期放缓、欧元过度升值或国内政治与财政不确定性达到峰值之时。2022至2026年的上行阶段证明，只要欧央行信用背书依然可信，法国可以在财政赤字高企的背景下持续较长时间的复苏。

ewg.summary: EWG is a highly cyclical, export-and-industry-heavy market whose USD returns are driven by three overlapping forces: the DAX's outsize weight in industrials, autos, chemicals, and financials; the EUR/USD exchange rate (a weaker euro depresses USD-denominated returns even when the DAX rises locally); and global risk appetite, since Germany's export machine is acutely sensitive to world trade volumes. Peaks have tended to coincide with EUR strength alongside strong global growth expectations; troughs have arrived when energy shocks, credit stress, or trade-war fears hit alongside EUR weakness. The loss of cheap Russian pipeline gas since 2022 added a structural energy-cost overhang on German industrial margins. Cycle lengths have run roughly 1-2 years peak-to-trough, with recoveries historically sharp once the macro catalyst clears.
ewg.summary_zh: EWG是一个高度周期性、以出口和工业为主导的市场，其美元回报由三股力量交织驱动：DAX指数对工业、汽车、化工和金融板块的高度集中；欧元兑美元汇率（即使DAX本地上涨，欧元走弱也会压低美元计价回报）；以及全球风险偏好（德国出口机器对全球贸易量极为敏感）。历次顶部往往伴随欧元走强与全球增长预期高涨；底部则在能源冲击、信贷压力或贸易战恐慌叠加欧元走弱时形成。2022年以来廉价俄罗斯管道天然气的切断给德国工业利润率带来结构性能源成本压力。峰谷周期通常为1至2年，一旦宏观催化剂消退，反弹往往迅猛。

ewd.summary: Sweden is a small, export-driven developed market with outsized exposure to global manufacturing cycles, European financial conditions, and domestic real-estate leverage. EWD's cycle is dictated by three interlocking forces: the Riksbank's monetary stance, the SEK/USD exchange rate which amplifies or erodes dollar-denominated returns, and the heavy weight of rate-sensitive property and banking stocks in the index. Tops tend to form when the SEK is rich, domestic property is stretched, and global PMIs roll over; troughs arrive after Riksbank easing, a depreciated SEK, and a recovery in global risk appetite. Sweden avoided the worst of the 2020 COVID contraction via lighter restrictions and a SEK 700bn Riksbank QE program, with GDP falling only about 3% in 2020 versus far steeper drops across the EU. The 2022 bear was unusually severe because Sweden's largely floating-rate mortgage market transmitted Riksbank hikes (zero to 4.0% by 2023) directly into household balance sheets, compressing listed property stocks by 50% or more.
ewd.summary_zh: 瑞典是一个小型出口导向型发达市场，高度依赖全球制造业周期、欧洲金融环境以及国内房地产杠杆。EWD的周期由三大相互交织的力量驱动：瑞典央行的货币政策立场、SEK/USD汇率（直接放大或侵蚀美元计价回报），以及指数中高度利率敏感型地产和银行股的权重。顶部通常在SEK偏贵、国内房地产过热、全球PMI掉头向下时形成；底部则在央行宽松、SEK已贬值且全球风险偏好回暖时出现。瑞典凭借相对宽松的疫情管控和7000亿克朗的央行量化宽松计划，2020年GDP仅萎缩约3%，远好于欧盟普遍更深的跌幅。2022年熊市异常惨烈，原因在于以浮动利率为主的抵押贷款市场将央行加息（2023年从零升至4.0%）直接传导至居民资产负债表，上市地产公司股价腰斩逾50%。

ewu.summary: EWU is shaped by three interlocking forces: sterling acting as a political-risk and fiscal-credibility barometer (Brexit, the 2022 gilt crisis), the FTSE 100's heavy weighting in commodity exporters and global financials that makes it a partial commodity and USD play in dollar terms, and the UK's persistent valuation discount to other developed markets. Cycle peaks tend to coincide with GBP strength and synchronized global growth; troughs follow sterling or fiscal shocks and sharp commodity drawdowns. Because EWU is USD-denominated, a falling pound compounds equity losses for dollar investors even when local shares hold steady (the index's overseas earners can even rise on a weak pound). The 2016 Brexit referendum and the 2022 Truss gilt crisis are the clearest structural fingerprints of this market.
ewu.summary_zh: EWU的周期特征由三股力量交织塑造：英镑作为政治风险与财政公信力的晴雨表（脱欧、2022年英国国债危机）、富时100对大宗商品出口商及全球金融股的高度集中（令其在美元计价下部分等同于商品/美元行情），以及英国市场相对其他发达市场的长期折价。周期顶部通常与英镑走强及全球同步增长重合；底部则往往伴随英镑或财政冲击及大宗商品急跌。由于ETF以美元计价，英镑贬值会在本地股票之上进一步放大美元投资者的亏损（而指数中的海外营收股甚至会因弱英镑而上涨）。2016年脱欧公投和2022年特拉斯预算危机，是该市场最清晰的结构性特征。

ewj.summary: Japan's USD-listed cycle is uniquely double-layered: every EWJ move reflects both the Nikkei's local performance AND the yen-dollar rate, making currency regime shifts the single most powerful lever. Abenomics (2012-2015) demonstrated this vividly, as a roughly 36% yen depreciation amplified export-sector gains into a 61% USD return for EWJ — with about half of that return pure currency translation. The reverse also holds: when the yen collapses faster than stocks can gain, USD returns suffer even as the Nikkei rises in local terms, as in 2021-2022 when EWJ fell 33% in dollars while local equities were roughly flat. Japan's index is heavily weighted toward exporters (autos, machinery, electronics) and financials, making it acutely sensitive to global trade volumes, USD/JPY direction, and BOJ policy stance. Cycle peaks have tended to coincide with yen exhaustion or global risk-off shocks; troughs are typically set by BOJ policy pivots, global reflation impulses, or deeply oversold exporter valuations.
ewj.summary_zh: EWJ的周期具有独特的双重结构：每次波动既反映日经的本地涨跌，也包含日元兑美元汇率变动，因此货币机制转换是最强的单一驱动力。安倍经济学（2012-2015年）是最典型的案例——日元贬值约36%将出口板块收益放大，推动EWJ以美元计上涨61%，其中约一半来自纯货币折算。反向逻辑同样成立：当日元贬值速度快于股市上涨时，即便日经以日元计上涨，美元回报仍会受损——2021至2022年日经以日元计大致持平，EWJ却以美元计下跌33%。日本指数高度集中于出口商（汽车、机械、电子）与金融股，对全球贸易量、美元兑日元走势及日银政策取向极为敏感。周期顶部往往与日元贬值耗尽或全球避险冲击重合；底部则通常由日银政策转向、全球再通胀或出口商估值严重低估所奠定。

ews.summary: Singapore's EWS is concentrated but not single-sector: financials are the largest block at roughly 38% of the index (DBS is the dominant single name, with OCBC and UOB also material), alongside meaningful weights in industrials, consumer/property, and telecom names such as Keppel, SingTel and ST Engineering. This makes the ETF a hybrid play on global credit and rate cycles, Asian trade and regional risk appetite rather than a pure bank basket. The SGD is a managed float that the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) steers via a nominal effective exchange rate (NEER) band, so USD/SGD moves are policy-mediated and far less volatile than typical EM currencies, dampening both upside and downside in dollar terms. Cycle tops have tended to coincide with peak global risk appetite, while troughs track global liquidity crunches and broad EM/Asia risk-off episodes. The 2022-2026 upcycle (+118%) is the strongest in the 15-year window, helped by higher-for-longer rates lifting bank net interest margins and a broad recovery in global and regional risk appetite.
ews.summary_zh: EWS 集中但并非单一行业：金融股是最大板块，约占指数 38%（星展为权重最大个股，华侨、大华亦有可观权重），同时凯德、新电信、新科工程等工业、消费/地产与电信名亦占相当比例。因此该 ETF 是对全球信贷与利率周期、亚洲贸易及区域风险偏好的混合敞口，而非纯粹的银行篮子。新加坡元由金管局通过 NEER 区间主动管理，汇率波动远低于一般新兴市场货币，对 EWS 的美元涨跌起平抑作用。周期顶部通常出现在全球风险偏好高峰，低谷则与全球流动性收缩及新兴市场/亚洲整体风险规避同步。2022—2026 年的上涨周期（+118%）是 15 年窗口中最强的一轮，得益于高息环境提振银行净息差以及全球与区域风险偏好的广泛回升。

ewc.summary: Canada's EWC cycle is overwhelmingly driven by commodity prices — energy (oil and gas) and materials (gold, potash, lumber) together account for a large share of the TSX. As a result, EWC peaks tend to coincide with commodity upcycles or risk-on rallies, while troughs align with oil crashes, global demand slumps, or trade disruption. The Canadian dollar amplifies these swings: a strong USD typically compresses USD-denominated returns for EWC holders, making currency a second-order but persistent drag during Fed tightening cycles. Canadian banks, the other large sector weighting, add a domestic-credit and housing-cycle overlay. Over the 15-year window, EWC moves have been large-amplitude but fewer in number than more volatile EM markets, reflecting Canada's status as a commodity-exporting developed market tightly coupled to the US economic cycle via the USMCA trade relationship.
ewc.summary_zh: EWC的周期主要由大宗商品价格驱动——能源（石油与天然气）及原材料（黄金、钾肥、木材）合计占TSX指数相当大的权重。因此，EWC的阶段性高点往往与大宗商品上行周期或风险偏好上行相吻合，低点则常与油价暴跌、全球需求萎缩或贸易摩擦对应。加元的汇率走势会放大这种波动：强美元时代，美元计价的EWC回报往往受到压制，在美联储紧缩周期中这是一个持续性的拖累因素。加拿大银行股是另一大权重板块，叠加国内信贷与房地产周期。过去15年，EWC的波动幅度较大但波段次数少于新兴市场，体现出加拿大作为大宗商品出口型发达国家、通过USMCA与美国经济周期高度绑定的特征。

ewa.summary: Australia's EWA cycle is anchored to three interlocking forces: global commodity prices (iron ore, coal and LNG dominate export earnings), the Chinese demand cycle (China absorbs roughly a third of Australian exports), and the AUD/USD exchange rate, which amplifies every local move for a USD investor. Bull legs tend to begin when China stimulus expectations firm, commodity prices bottom and the AUD recovers from oversold levels; bear legs are typically driven by China slowdown fears, commodity-price collapses or sharp AUD devaluations. The Australian equity market is heavily concentrated in financials (the Big Four banks) and materials (BHP, Rio Tinto), so shocks in either group can override macro tailwinds. Historically, tops have coincided with stretched commodity prices and a firm AUD, while troughs have formed during synchronized global risk-off episodes or sharp AUD sell-offs.
ewa.summary_zh: EWA的周期由三大相互交织的力量主导：全球大宗商品价格（铁矿石、煤炭、液化天然气占出口收入主导地位）、中国需求周期（中国吸收约三分之一的澳大利亚出口）以及澳元/美元汇率——后者对以美元计价的投资者而言会放大每一次本地市场的涨跌。牛市腿通常在中国刺激预期升温、大宗商品价格触底、澳元从超卖水平回升时启动；熊市腿则往往由中国经济放缓担忧、大宗商品价格崩塌或澳元急剧贬值所驱动。澳大利亚股市高度集中于金融（四大银行）和材料（必和必拓、力拓）板块，单一板块的冲击可以压过宏观顺风。从历史上看，顶部通常伴随大宗商品价格偏高且澳元走强，底部则形成于全球同步风险规避或澳元大幅抛售期间。

ewh.summary: EWH is structurally a China-proxy with a dollar peg: the HKD is fixed to the USD, so the ETF carries no FX cushion for USD investors and all volatility is pure equity volatility. The Hang Seng is heavily concentrated in financials and China-linked technology, making it acutely sensitive to Beijing's regulatory posture, mainland property-sector health, and US interest rates transmitted via the peg. Cycles in EWH are characteristically long and violent: multi-year bull runs powered by mainland capital inflows and China credit expansion, followed by sharp drawdowns triggered by regulatory shocks or global liquidity tightening. Tops typically follow stretched valuations after mainland-driven euphoria; troughs tend to be event-driven capitulations that overshoot to the downside.
ewh.summary_zh: EWH 在结构上是一个挂钩美元的中国代理市场：港元与美元固定汇率，令 USD 投资者缺乏汇率缓冲，所有波动均为纯股票波动。恒生指数高度集中于金融股及与中国内地相关的科技股，对北京监管立场、内地房地产健康状况以及通过联系汇率传导的美国利率极为敏感。EWH 的周期特征是长而剧烈：由内地资金流入和中国信贷扩张驱动的多年牛市，随后因监管冲击或全球流动性收紧而急剧回调。顶部通常伴随内地情绪驱动的估值过度扩张，而底部则往往是超跌的事件驱动式投降。

ewy.summary: South Korea (EWY) is among the most semiconductor-concentrated major country ETFs: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix together routinely account for roughly 40-55% of index weight, making EWY behave more like a leveraged memory-chip cycle play than a diversified country basket. Tops have historically coincided with memory ASP/inventory peaks, stretched valuations, and global risk-off; troughs have aligned with memory downcycles, Fed-driven dollar strength and EM outflows, or acute domestic political shocks. The KRW/USD rate is a permanent secondary driver -- a ~10% KRW depreciation mechanically subtracts roughly that amount from EWY's USD return even if the local KOSPI is flat. Korea outperforms SPY sharply in global tech upcycles and lags severely when risk appetite collapses or the dollar strengthens, producing some of the largest amplitude swings among country ETFs.
ewy.summary_zh: 韩国（EWY）是半导体集中度最高的主要国家ETF之一：三星电子与SK海力士合计权重通常约40-55%，使EWY的表现更像一支杠杆式内存芯片周期产品，而非分散化的国家篮子。顶部历史上往往对应内存均价/库存峰值、估值拉伸及全球风险规避；底部则与内存下行周期、美联储紧缩引发的美元走强与新兴市场资金外流，或国内政治冲击相吻合。韩元/美元汇率是永久性的二阶驱动因素——韩元贬值约10%，即便KOSPI本地指数持平，EWY美元收益率也将同步缩水约10%。韩国在全球科技上行周期中大幅跑赢SPY，而在风险偏好崩塌或美元走强时严重落后，振幅是国家ETF中最大的之一。

ewt.summary: Taiwan's equity cycle is driven almost entirely by the global semiconductor capex and demand cycle, with TSMC and its supply-chain ecosystem accounting for roughly two-thirds to three-quarters of the index. Tops have historically coincided with semiconductor inventory gluts, sharp Fed tightening, or China-shock risk-off episodes; troughs have been set by global policy easing and the onset of new demand up-cycles (mobile, server/cloud, AI). The TWD is a secondary amplifier: when global risk appetite is on, foreign inflows strengthen the currency and lift USD returns, while risk-off TWD weakness clips them. Cross-strait tension and US-China tech restrictions add an asymmetric geopolitical downside tail unique to this market that rarely prices in fully at peaks.
ewt.summary_zh: 台湾股市周期几乎完全由全球半导体资本开支与需求周期驱动，台积电及其供应链生态约占指数权重的三分之二至四分之三。历史顶部通常出现于半导体库存过剩、美联储激进加息或中国冲击引发的风险规避阶段；底部则由全球政策宽松及新一轮需求上行周期（移动端、服务器/云、AI）奠定。新台币是次级放大器：全球风险偏好上行时，外资流入推升汇率并放大美元回报；风险规避时台币走弱则侵蚀美元收益。两岸紧张局势与美中科技限制构成该市场独有的非对称地缘下行尾部风险，在高峰期通常未被充分定价。

inda.summary: India's cycle is driven by the interplay of domestic growth narratives, foreign institutional investor (FII) flow sensitivity, rupee direction versus the USD, and periodic valuation resets. As a large, domestically-oriented EM, INDA responds strongly to global risk-on/risk-off through the FII channel: when global dollar liquidity tightens, FIIs sell and the rupee tends to weaken at the same time, compounding the USD-return drawdown. Tops tend to be stretched-valuation events where earnings expectations and FII inflows peak together; troughs are typically driven by global rate or liquidity shocks (and occasionally domestic policy disruptions) that trigger simultaneous equity and currency selloffs. The structural bull since 2013 has been punctuated by sharp but recoverable drawdowns -- taper tantrum, EM/China scare, demonetization, COVID -- each followed by resumption of the long-term growth premium. For USD-based investors, INR/USD direction can meaningfully amplify or blunt local-equity returns over a cycle leg.
inda.summary_zh: 印度市场周期由国内增长叙事、外资（FII）流动敏感性、卢比兑美元走势以及周期性估值重置共同驱动。作为一个以内需为主的大型新兴市场，INDA通过FII渠道对全球风险偏好变化反应强烈——当全球美元流动性收紧时，FII倾向于抛售，卢比往往同步走弱，从而放大以美元计价的回撤。市场顶部通常出现在估值拉伸、盈利预期与FII流入同步见顶之时；底部则多由全球利率或流动性冲击（有时叠加国内政策扰动）引发，表现为股市与货币的同步下跌。2013年以来的结构性牛市被多次急促但可恢复的回撤所打断——缩债恐慌、新兴市场/中国恐慌、去货币化、新冠——每次之后均恢复长期增长溢价。对美元投资者而言，印卢汇率走向可在一个周期内显著放大或削弱本地股票回报。

fxi.summary: FXI tracks China's largest H-share and red-chip companies listed in Hong Kong — concentrated in state-owned financials, energy, and a handful of internet giants — so every cycle carries a dual overlay: onshore Chinese equity fundamentals plus the CNY/HKD-versus-USD exchange rate. The structural driver is policy: Beijing's stimulus pulses, regulatory campaigns, and credit cycles dominate far more than the global earnings cycle that drives developed-market ETFs. Peaks have arrived when leverage, policy euphoria, or foreign-inflow narratives became extended; troughs have been marked by regulatory shock, property-sector stress, or geopolitical escalation. The concentrated, low-diversification basket amplifies both policy-easing rallies and crackdown drawdowns. Over the trailing 15-year window the rolling return is only about +5% in USD terms — large tactical swings have been nearly fully offset by FX headwinds and the absence of durable per-share earnings growth.
fxi.summary_zh: FXI追踪在香港上市的中国最大H股及红筹股，集中于国有金融、能源以及少数互联网巨头，因此每轮周期均叠加双重因素：中国境内股票基本面与人民币/港元兑美元汇率。其结构性驱动力是政策——北京的刺激脉冲、监管运动与信贷周期，远比主导发达市场ETF的全球盈利周期更为关键。峰值往往出现在杠杆、政策乐观或外资流入叙事过度拉伸之时；低谷则多由监管冲击、房地产压力或地缘政治升级触发。高度集中、低分散度的持仓既放大了政策宽松期的涨幅，也加剧了打压期的回撤。过去15年滚动窗口的美元回报仅约+5%——巨大的战术性波动几乎被汇率逆风和缺乏可持续每股盈利增长所完全抵消。

eido.summary: Indonesia (EIDO) is the emerging-market cycle most dominated by a single structural vulnerability: the rupiah. The USD-listed ETF is a joint bet on Indonesian equities AND the rupiah vs the dollar, so every global risk-off episode that strengthens the dollar hits it from both directions at once, making it a textbook Fragile-Five high-beta name. Tops have formed when the current-account deficit widens amid USD strength and capital outflows; troughs emerge after the rupiah stabilizes, commodity prices recover, or domestic reform catalysts pull foreign capital back in. The deepest down-legs (2013 taper tantrum, 2014-15 commodity bear, 2026 fiscal-credibility shock) all paired currency weakness with falling local equities. Major up-legs have been commodity-led (coal, palm oil, nickel) combined with dollar softness or domestic reform. The ETF's multi-year USD return is negative, underscoring how persistent currency drag can overwhelm decent local-equity performance for dollar-based investors.
eido.summary_zh: 印尼（EIDO）是新兴市场中最受单一结构性脆弱性主导的国家ETF：其周期高度受印尼盾左右。这只以美元计价的ETF本质上是印尼股票与印尼盾兑美元的双重押注，因此每次全球避险、美元走强，它就会同时遭受股票和汇率两个方向的冲击，是典型的'脆弱五国'高贝塔标的。历次顶部均在经常账户赤字扩大、美元走强及资本外流时形成；底部则往往在印尼盾企稳、大宗商品价格回升或国内改革催化剂重新吸引外资后出现。最深的下跌段（2013年缩减恐慌、2014-15年大宗商品熊市、2026年财政公信力冲击）均是汇率走弱叠加本地股票下跌。主要上升段则由大宗商品（煤炭、棕榈油、镍）景气叠加美元走软或国内改革驱动。该ETF多年美元计价总回报为负，深刻揭示了持续的汇率拖累如何抵消尚可的本地股票表现。

eww.summary: Mexico's equity cycle turns on three interlocking forces: the MXN/USD exchange rate, the US trade and tariff relationship, and the domestic macro and political backdrop. Because EWW is USD-denominated, a falling peso can erase local-market gains entirely while a strong peso amplifies them — FX is often the dominant swing factor in any given leg. Oil and energy receipts set the fiscal floor: Pemex weakness or falling crude drains the federal budget (oil historically supplied roughly a third of public-sector revenue) and pressures the currency. Peaks tend to coincide with peso strength, easy US financial conditions, and strong US manufacturing and nearshoring demand; troughs follow peso sell-offs, US protectionist shocks, or domestic political and reform uncertainty. The index is concentrated in consumer, financial, and telecom names, making it less commodity-driven than Brazil but more FX-sensitive than most EM peers.
eww.summary_zh: 墨西哥股市周期由三股相互交织的力量主导：比索兑美元汇率、美墨贸易与关税关系，以及国内宏观与政治背景。由于EWW以美元计价，比索贬值可完全抵消本地股市涨幅，而比索升值则起放大效应——汇率往往是任一波段的主导变量。石油收入是财政底线：Pemex业绩恶化或油价下跌会侵蚀联邦预算（历史上石油约占公共部门收入三分之一）并施压汇率。周期顶部往往出现在比索强势、美国金融条件宽松、美国制造业及近岸需求旺盛时期；底部则多发生在比索大幅贬值、美国贸易保护主义冲击或国内政治与改革不确定性上升之后。指数集中于消费、金融和电信板块，商品驱动低于巴西，但汇率敏感性高于大多数新兴市场同类。

ech.summary: ECH is overwhelmingly a copper-and-peso proxy: Chile produces roughly one-quarter of the world's copper, and the ETF's materials and financials backbone means commodity cycles, not domestic earnings growth, dictate the multi-year swings. The USD-denominated return is a double lever — copper up tends to pull both Chilean equities and the Chilean peso higher, compounding gains; copper down reverses both. Political risk is a secondary but significant amplifier: the 2019 social uprising and the 2020-2023 constitutional rewrite saga repeatedly moved the peso and stretched ECH drawdowns and recoveries beyond what pure commodity mechanics would imply. Notably, markets treated the resolution of constitutional uncertainty (both referendum rejections, in 2022 and 2023) as a positive, since it removed the tail risk of radical mining and property reform. Tops tend to form when copper is elevated and political sentiment is buoyant; troughs are deepest when a commodity downturn coincides with domestic or global stress. Lithium (SQM) adds a second commodity dimension, tying the ETF to battery-metals demand as well.
ech.summary_zh: ECH 本质上是铜价与比索的双重代理：智利生产全球约四分之一的铜，ETF以材料和金融板块为主，意味着大宗商品周期而非国内盈利增长主导多年级别的涨跌。美元计价回报具有双重杠杆——铜价上涨往往同时推升智利股市与比索，收益叠加；铜价下跌则两者齐跌。政治风险是第二个重要放大器：2019年社会动荡与2020-2023年的制宪进程反复扰动比索，并将ECH的回撤与修复拉长至超出纯大宗商品逻辑的程度。值得注意的是，市场把制宪不确定性的消除（2022年与2023年两次公投否决）解读为利好，因为这消除了激进矿业与产权改革的尾部风险。顶部通常形成于铜价高位且政治情绪乐观之时；底部最深处往往是大宗商品下行与国内或全球压力叠加之际。锂矿（SQM）增添了第二个商品维度，令ETF同时受电池金属需求影响。

ewz.summary: EWZ is structurally a commodity-and-carry play wrapped in a highly volatile political wrapper. The ETF's index is dominated by Petrobras, Vale, and the major banks — so iron ore, crude oil, agricultural prices, and global risk appetite jointly set the floor and ceiling of each cycle. The BRL is procyclical: it amplifies gains in commodity booms and deepens losses in risk-off episodes, making USD-denominated swings far larger than the underlying local-currency moves. Political regime changes — Dilma's impeachment, Bolsonaro's election, Lula's return — have each produced sharp re-rating jolts. Brazil's chronic fiscal-credibility problem (primary deficits, rising public debt-to-GDP) acts as a permanent drag on multiples, capping sustainable upside and shortening cycles relative to DM peers. Tops have typically formed when commodity prices and the BRL are near cycle highs together; troughs form after political or fiscal shocks that collapse the real.
ewz.summary_zh: EWZ在结构上是一个裹着高波动政治外衣的大宗商品与套息组合。ETF指数以巴西国家石油公司、淡水河谷及主要银行为主导，铁矿石、原油、农产品价格与全球风险偏好共同决定每轮周期的底部与顶部。雷亚尔具有顺周期性：在大宗商品繁荣时放大涨幅，在风险规避时加深跌幅，使美元计价的波动远大于本币涨跌。政治政权更迭——迪尔玛下台、博索纳罗当选、卢拉回归——每次都引发剧烈的重新定价。巴西长期财政公信力问题（基本赤字、债务/GDP持续攀升）对估值倍数构成永久性拖累，令可持续上行空间受限、周期相对发达市场更短。顶部通常在大宗商品价格与雷亚尔同步处于周期高位时形成；底部则在政治或财政冲击令雷亚尔崩跌后出现。

epol.summary: Poland is a mid-size Central European emerging market whose cycle is anchored to the eurozone economy and NATO security architecture. EPOL's USD returns layer PLN/USD currency risk on top of Warsaw Stock Exchange dynamics, so a strengthening dollar — common in global risk-off episodes — amplifies drawdowns, and a recovering zloty amplifies up-legs. The index is concentrated in financials (banks) and energy/materials, so domestic credit conditions, NBP interest-rate policy, and commodity prices exert outsized influence. Geopolitical proximity to Russia creates a distinct risk-premium dynamic: when Eastern European tensions escalate, Polish equities and the zloty tend to sell off together, compounding USD-denominated losses, while de-escalation drives sharp re-rating. Poland's strongest bull legs have come from the combination of EU structural-fund inflows, eurozone recovery cycles, and — most powerfully in the 2023-2026 run — the political pivot to a pro-EU government that unlocked frozen EU funds.
epol.summary_zh: 波兰是一个中等规模的中欧新兴市场，其周期锚定于欧元区经济与北约安全框架。EPOL的美元回报在华沙证交所本地表现之上叠加了兹罗提/美元汇率风险，因此全球避险时常见的美元走强会放大跌幅，而兹罗提回升则放大涨幅。指数集中于金融（银行）和能源/材料板块，国内信贷环境、波兰国家银行利率政策及大宗商品价格均产生超额影响。与俄罗斯的地缘毗邻形成独特的风险溢价机制：东欧紧张局势升级时，波兰股市与兹罗提往往同步下跌，加剧美元计价损失，而局势缓和则带来大幅重估。波兰最强劲的牛市来自欧盟结构性基金流入、欧元区复苏周期，以及在2023-2026年行情中最为关键的——转向亲欧盟政府并解锁冻结的欧盟资金。

tur.summary: Turkey (TUR) is among the most FX-dominated country ETFs in EM: the lira has lost roughly 90%+ against the USD since 2013, so even powerful local equity bull markets can deliver flat or negative USD returns. Cycles are driven by three overlapping forces — the TRY/USD exchange rate, domestic inflation and CBRT credibility, and global EM risk appetite. USD-term bull legs require either a temporary lira stabilization or local equity surges violent enough to outpace FX drag (most extreme in 2021-22, when Borsa Istanbul acted as an inflation hedge). Tops form when lira stress re-emerges, the current-account deficit widens, or EMFX selling accelerates; troughs form when policy orthodoxy is restored, real rates turn positive, and global risk appetite rebounds.
tur.summary_zh: 土耳其（TUR）是新兴市场中受汇率驱动最显著的国家ETF之一：自2013年以来里拉兑美元已贬值约九成以上，因此即便本地股市出现强劲牛市，以美元计价的回报也可能持平甚至为负。周期由三重力量叠加驱动：TRY/USD汇率、国内通胀与土央行公信力、全球新兴市场风险偏好。美元口径的牛市需要里拉阶段性企稳，或本地涨幅猛烈到足以抵消汇损（2021-22年最为极端，当时博尔萨伊斯坦布尔成为通胀对冲工具）。顶部通常在里拉压力重现、经常账户赤字扩大或新兴市场货币遭抛售时形成；低点则多在政策回归正统、实际利率转正、全球风险偏好回暖后触发。

eza.summary: South Africa via EZA is a high-beta, commodity-and-politics-driven EM market where USD returns stack three compounding layers: JSE equity prices, the rand-dollar exchange rate, and global risk appetite. Cycles are frequently triggered by domestic political inflection points — leadership changes, election outcomes, cabinet shocks — that either unlock or destroy investor confidence in the reform story. The commodity tilt (gold, platinum-group metals, miners) amplifies global commodity cycles and ties EZA to China's industrial demand and broad USD strength. Tops have tended to coincide with peak political optimism and elevated commodity prices; troughs with governance crises, load-shedding paralysis, or EM-wide risk-off. EZA's 15-year cycle amplitude is extreme — legs running roughly 35% to 160% — because the currency multiplier sits on top of an already volatile equity market.
eza.summary_zh: EZA所代表的南非市场是一个高贝塔、受大宗商品与政治双重驱动的新兴市场。美元计价回报叠加约翰内斯堡交易所股价、兰特汇率与全球风险偏好三个层面。市场周期常由国内政治拐点触发——领导层更迭、选举结果、内阁震荡——这些因素决定投资者对改革前景的信心。大宗商品敞口（黄金、铂族金属、矿业股）放大了全球商品周期的影响，并将EZA与中国工业需求和美元走势绑定。顶部通常出现在政治乐观情绪高峰叠加商品价格走高之际，谷底则多与治理危机、电力短缺或新兴市场整体避险相关。过去15年EZA的周期振幅极为剧烈——单边行情幅度大致在35%至160%之间，汇率乘数效应是关键放大器。

efa.summary: EFA is structurally a euro-centric, USD-sensitive multi-bloc basket -- roughly two-thirds Europe, about one-fifth Japan, and the remainder in other Pacific markets. Its cycle is governed by three interlocking forces: EUR/USD and JPY/USD exchange rates (which translate local-currency returns into USD gains or losses), ECB and BoJ policy posture relative to the Fed, and the global risk-appetite cycle that sets how much premium investors assign to cheaper non-US valuations. Up-legs have required at least one of a falling dollar, a European re-rating catalyst (an ECB backstop or fiscal expansion), or a synchronised global growth upswing; down-legs have come from dollar strength, European financial or energy stress, or broad risk-off episodes. The index's heavy bank, industrial, and energy weighting means European sovereign stress and commodity shocks hit it disproportionately hard.
efa.summary_zh: EFA结构上以欧元区为核心、对美元高度敏感，约三分之二为欧洲、约五分之一为日本、其余为其他亚太市场。其周期由三大相互交织的力量驱动：欧元/美元和日元/美元汇率（将本币回报转换为美元收益或损失）、欧央行与日央行相对美联储的政策立场，以及决定投资者愿为非美市场估值折价给予多少溢价的全球风险偏好周期。上升腿通常至少需要美元走弱、欧洲重新定价催化剂（欧央行背书或财政扩张）或同步全球增长三者之一；下行腿则源于美元走强、欧洲金融或能源压力或全面避险情绪。该指数银行、工业与能源权重偏高，欧洲主权债务压力和大宗商品冲击对其打击尤为明显。

vgk.summary: VGK is a broad developed-Europe basket spanning the UK, France, Germany, Switzerland, the Netherlands, and the Nordic markets, making it acutely sensitive to three interlocking forces: the EUR/USD and GBP/USD exchange rate (which amplifies or negates local equity moves for USD-based holders), the global risk-appetite cycle (European cyclicals, banks, and luxury goods dominate the index), and energy-price shocks given the continent's import dependence. Tops have coincided with stretched EUR valuations, hawkish ECB pivots, and global growth scares, while troughs have aligned with peak pessimism on European sovereign risk, energy crises, or recession fears - moments where both sentiment and currency were simultaneously washed out. The September 2022 to February 2026 advance is the longest sustained up-move in the 15-year window, built on the energy-crisis floor, Chinese reopening demand for European luxury and industrials, and persistent USD softening that amplified USD-denominated returns.
vgk.summary_zh: VGK涵盖英国、法国、德国、瑞士、荷兰及北欧等主要发达欧洲市场，其走势受三大核心力量主导：欧元/美元与英镑/美元汇率（可放大或抵消本地股票涨跌）、全球风险偏好周期（欧洲周期股、银行股与奢侈品股在指数中占主导），以及能源价格冲击（欧洲高度依赖能源进口）。历史顶部往往与欧元估值偏高、欧央行鹰派转向及全球增长担忧同步出现；历史底部则一致出现在欧洲主权风险、能源危机或衰退恐慌情绪极度悲观之际，彼时股票与货币双双超卖。2022年9月至2026年2月的上涨是15年窗口内持续时间最长的走势，由能源危机筑底、中国重开拉动欧洲奢侈品与工业品需求以及美元持续走软共同驱动。

vpl.summary: VPL tracks the FTSE Developed Asia Pacific index: Japan dominates at roughly 56% of weight, with South Korea (~18%), Australia (~16%), plus smaller Hong Kong, Singapore, and New Zealand sleeves. It is structurally a Japan-plus-Korea-tech-plus-Australia-commodity proxy. Because it is a USD ETF, every leg compounds the local equity move with the yen (and to a lesser degree the won and Aussie dollar) versus the dollar: when the yen weakens, USD returns are muted even as Tokyo rallies in local terms; when the yen strengthens, USD returns overshoot or get crushed depending on direction. Japan's cycle is driven by BOJ policy pivots, global risk appetite for export cyclicals (autos, machinery, semiconductors), and the pace of corporate governance reform. Korea adds the global semiconductor/memory cycle (Samsung, SK Hynix). Australia adds commodity sensitivity (iron ore, energy) and RBA dynamics. Troughs in VPL tend to coincide with global risk-off events, while peaks have repeatedly clustered around BOJ tightening signals or sharp yen-appreciation episodes that compress USD returns even when local markets hold.
vpl.summary_zh: VPL追踪富时发达亚太指数：日本以约56%的权重占主导，韩国（约18%）、澳大利亚（约16%），以及较小的香港、新加坡和新西兰部分。本质上是「日本+韩国科技+澳大利亚大宗商品」的代理组合。由于是美元ETF，每一段走势的美元回报都叠加了日元（以及程度较小的韩元和澳元）兑美元的汇率影响：日元走弱时即便东京本地上涨，美元回报也会受压；日元走强时，美元回报则会随方向被放大或被压垮。日本周期由日本央行政策转向、全球对出口周期股（汽车、机械、半导体）的风险偏好以及公司治理改革进程驱动。韩国带来全球半导体/存储周期（三星、SK海力士）。澳大利亚带来大宗商品敏感性（铁矿石、能源）和澳联储动态。VPL的低点往往与全球风险规避事件同步，而峰值则多次集中在日本央行紧缩信号或日元急升行情前后——即便本地市场企稳，美元回报也会被压缩。

eem.summary: EEM is a market-cap-weighted proxy for the emerging world, dominated by China (roughly 25-30%), Taiwan (around 20%), India (around 18%), and South Korea (around 12%), making it simultaneously a bet on Asian technology supply chains, Chinese policy cycles, and commodity-linked EM currencies. Its cycles are structurally driven by the US dollar — a weakening dollar has tended to be a prerequisite for a durable EM bull leg, easing dollar-denominated debt burdens and drawing capital toward higher-yielding EM assets. Peaks tend to cluster around Fed tightening cycles and/or China credit slowdowns; troughs typically require both a Fed pivot signal and evidence of stabilizing Chinese growth. The growing weight of Taiwan and South Korea tech means semiconductor cycles now co-drive EEM alongside the traditional commodity and EM-currency channels. FX amplification is a defining feature: every leg in USD terms combines local-equity moves with the EM currency basket versus the dollar.
eem.summary_zh: EEM是新兴世界的市值加权综合代理，目前由中国（约25-30%）、台湾（约20%）、印度（约18%）、韩国（约12%）主导，因此同时是亚洲科技供应链、中国政策周期与大宗商品挂钩型新兴市场货币的组合押注。其周期结构上由美元主导——美元走弱往往是持续性新兴市场牛市腿的先决条件，因为它能减轻美元计价债务负担并将资本吸引至收益率更高的新兴市场资产。顶部往往聚集在美联储紧缩周期和/或中国信贷放缓附近；底部通常需要美联储政策转向信号与中国增长企稳的双重确认。随着台湾和韩国科技权重提升，半导体周期现在与传统大宗商品和新兴市场货币渠道共同驱动EEM。汇率放大效应是其定义性特征：每一段以美元计量的涨跌，均叠加了本地股票走势与新兴市场货币篮子对美元的变化。

aaxj.summary: AAXJ is a high-beta, tech-heavy Asia ex-Japan composite. China is the largest single weight (roughly a third including Hong Kong), followed by Taiwan, India and South Korea; by mid-2026 Taiwan's weight has risen materially on the semiconductor surge. Its cycle is structurally driven by three interlocking forces: China's policy and growth cycle, the global semiconductor capex wave anchored in Taiwan and Korea, and the USD and EM liquidity backdrop. Bull legs tend to begin when global risk appetite recovers, China growth expectations stabilise or re-accelerate, and the dollar softens; bear legs reflect the reverse — Fed tightening compressing EM multiples, China regulatory or growth shocks, or Taiwan/Korea tech-cycle downturns. Because the ETF is USD-denominated, Asian currency depreciation compresses USD returns even when local markets hold up. Tops have historically coincided with China credit tightening, US rate peaks turning into tighter-for-longer rhetoric, or sector blow-offs in tech. Troughs have been carved by extreme EM risk-off, China stimulus signals, or credible Fed pivot expectations.
aaxj.summary_zh: AAXJ是一只高贝塔、科技重仓的亚洲（除日本）综合ETF。中国是单一最大权重（含香港约占三分之一），其后依次为台湾、印度与韩国；到2026年年中，台湾权重因半导体行情而明显上升。其周期结构由三股力量主导：中国政策与增长周期、以台湾和韩国为核心的全球半导体资本开支浪潮，以及美元与新兴市场流动性环境。牛市通常在全球风险偏好回暖、中国增长预期企稳或上修、美元走弱三者共振时启动；熊市则是上述条件逆转——美联储紧缩压制新兴市场估值、中国监管或增长冲击、或台韩科技周期下行。由于ETF以美元计价，亚洲货币贬值（人民币、韩元、台币）即便本地市场企稳，也会明显压缩美元回报。历史顶部往往与中国信贷收紧、美国利率由峰值转向更长时间高位的预期、或科技板块的阶段性泡沫破裂相吻合；底部则由极端新兴市场风险厌恶、中国刺激信号或美联储明确转向预期所铸就。

ilf.summary: ILF is a USD-priced proxy for Latin American large-caps (S&P Latin America 40), with Brazil typically ~50-55% of weight, followed by Mexico and Chile. Its largest constituents are Brazilian miners, energy, and banks — Vale, Petrobras, Itau, Nu Holdings — so every cycle is a compound of local equity moves AND the BRL/MXN versus the USD: a depreciating real can erase local-currency gains in dollar terms. The index is deeply commodity-sensitive, with iron ore, oil, and copper driving earnings at the top names, and China is the marginal buyer of those exports. The two most reliable regime-switchers are Brazilian political/fiscal risk (corruption cycles, fiscal slippage) and global EM-vs-DM risk appetite. Tops tend to coincide with currency exhaustion and fiscal slippage; troughs tend to coincide with commodity washouts and political/fiscal crisis climaxes.
ilf.summary_zh: ILF是以美元计价的拉丁美洲大盘股代理工具（标普拉美40指数），巴西通常占权重约50-55%，其次为墨西哥和智利。最大成分股为巴西矿业、能源与银行股——淡水河谷、巴西国家石油公司、伊塔乌、Nu Holdings——因此每一个周期都是本地股市表现与雷亚尔/比索兑美元汇率变动的叠加：雷亚尔贬值可将本币涨幅在美元口径下抹去。指数对大宗商品高度敏感，铁矿石、原油和铜主导头部成分股盈利，而中国是这些出口品的边际买家。最可靠的两个政权切换器是巴西政治/财政风险（腐败周期、财政滑坡）以及全球新兴市场与发达市场的风险偏好。顶部往往与货币耗尽和财政滑坡同步；底部则倾向于与大宗商品深度洗盘及政治/财政危机高峰重合。
drivers: Brazil weight ~50-55%: BRL/USD is the dominant FX lever on USD returns
Commodity complex: iron ore and copper (Vale), oil (Petrobras) drive earnings
Global risk appetite: EM-vs-DM rotation determines flows
Brazil political/fiscal risk: spending discipline and elections are the key swing factor
China demand: marginal buyer of iron ore, copper, and soybeans from the region

中国需求：本地区铁矿石、铜与大豆的边际买家

vxus.summary: VXUS is a broad all-world ex-US wrapper whose cycles are driven by three interlocking forces: the US dollar cycle, global growth synchronization, and ex-US versus US equity valuation spreads. Because the ETF is unhedged, every leg reflects local equity returns AND the net move of a trade-weighted foreign-currency basket versus the USD -- dollar bear phases amplify up-legs, dollar bull phases amplify down-legs. Tops tend to form when US growth and rates diverge upward from the rest of the world, lifting the dollar and compressing overseas multiples; troughs tend to coincide with a peaking dollar, a synchronized global recovery, and wide ex-US valuation discounts to US equities. Europe (the largest regional weight), Japan, and EM Asia are the biggest swing factors, and EM currencies add a second amplification layer that makes deep drawdowns sharper and early-cycle bounces steeper than a developed-market-only basket.
vxus.summary_zh: VXUS是覆盖全球除美国全部资产的宽基ETF，其周期由三大相互交织的力量驱动：美元周期、全球经济增长同步性，以及非美相对美股的估值价差。由于该ETF不做货币对冲，每一个上行或下行段都同时反映本地股票回报与外汇兑美元的综合变动——美元熊市放大上涨、美元牛市放大下跌。顶部通常在美国增长与利率相对全球显著偏高时形成，推升美元并压制海外估值倍数；低谷则往往与美元见顶、全球同步复苏及非美相对美股估值大幅折价同步出现。欧洲（区域权重最大）、日本和亚洲新兴市场是三大摆动因子，新兴市场货币还提供第二层放大效应，使深度回调更陡峭、早周期反弹强于纯发达市场篮子。
drivers: USD cycle: unhedged FX is the single largest performance multiplier
Global growth sync: outperforms when non-US PMIs converge upward with the US
Valuation spread vs SPY: wide ex-US discounts have historically preceded multi-year outperformance
EM currency beta: EM FX amplifies both drawdowns and recoveries
Policy divergence: Fed vs ECB/BOJ rate gaps drive relative flows
drivers_zh: 美元周期：未对冲的汇率敞口是最大的业绩放大器
全球增长同步：非美PMI与美国同步回升时跑赢
相对SPY估值价差：非美大幅折价后历史上往往引发多年超额回报
新兴市场货币贝塔：新兴市场汇率对回调与复苏均有放大作用
政策分化：美联储与欧央行/日央行的利率差驱动相对资金流向
top_signals: Top signals: DXY turning to sustained strength + US-vs-rest-of-world growth divergence widening + ex-US earnings revisions rolling over
Trough signals: DXY rolling over from a multi-year high + synchronized global PMI upturn + ex-US P/E at a historically wide discount to the S&P 500
top_signals_zh: 顶部信号：美元指数转入持续走强 + 美国与其他国家增长差距扩大 + 非美盈利预期下修
低谷信号：美元指数从多年高位回落 + 全球PMI同步回升 + 非美市盈率相对标普500折价扩大至历史极端水平
